summary: Aklan 2nd District representative with 223 principal-authored bills. Authored travel-tax abolition; co-authored the national minimum wage, a daily wage increase and anti-dynasty bills. One issue per dimension. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Few rubric-relevant bills surfaced; the rest of the portfolio was not individually reviewed.
